description: Retrospective application for installation of 1 no. gas riser to the rear elevation and installation of micro-stop to existing riser with associated internal works to Flats 1-5 (Listed Building ref: P2026/2186/LBC also submitted)
decision_conditions:
DRAWING AND DOCUMENT NUMBERS:  The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

26001921_PLN_EL_1.1 – Pre-Existing North & Return Elevations, 26001921_PLN_EL_1.2 – Existing North & Return Elevations, 26001921_PLN_FL_2.1 – Pre-Existing & Existing Flat 1 Floor Plan, 26001921_PLN_FL_2.2 - Pre-Existing & Existing Flat 2 Assumed Floor Plan, 26001921_PLN_FL_2.3 - Pre-Existing & Existing Flat 3 Assumed Floor Plan, 26001921_PLN_FL_2.4 - Pre-Existing & Existing Flat 4 Floor Plan, 26001921_PLN_FL_2.5 - Pre-Existing & Existing Flat 5 Floor Plan, 26001921_PLN_IEL_3.1 – Pre-Existing & Existing Internal Elevations, 26001921_PLN_IEL_3.3 - Pre-Existing & Existing Internal Elevations, 26001921_PLN_LOC_4.1 – Location Plan, 26001921_PLN_SI_5.1 – Site Plan, 26001921_PLN_SI_6.1 – Block Plan, Design Access & Heritage Statement prepared by Dalcour Maclaren (dated May 2026), Sustainable Design & Construction Statement (undated), Fire Statement (Issue 01) prepared by Bureau Veritas (dated 27/04/2026)
